scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @qdral/mcp && npm run build --workspace @qdral/relay
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @qdral/mcp && npm run build --workspace @qdral/mcp && npm run typecheck --workspace @qdral/relay
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace @qdral/mcp && npm run test --workspace @qdral/relay && npm run browser-worker:test
scripts.browser-worker:test: npm ci --prefix apps/qdral-browser-worker --ignore-scripts && npm --prefix apps/qdral-browser-worker run typecheck && npm --prefix apps/qdral-browser-worker test
